name: Dorota Piotrowiak (SDXL/QWEN/Z IMAGE)
description: Dorota Piotrowiak is a professional artist who works in painting, sculpture, and graphics. Known for her stunning portraits of women, as well as her life size paper sculptures of plants and animals, Dorota is an award-winning artist with works in major private collections and museums around the world. Her paintings of birds, insects and animals travel all over the country and abroad. Dorota Piotrowiak, born in 1969 in Poland, is a pioneer in many creative techniques, including graphic design, computer design, AI modifications, art prints, oil and acryl on canvas. Using several techniques in each creation, including sculpting, clay sculptures, papier-mâché models/forms, all her works are “mixed technique” art objects.
